title: First-person tools: variations
desc: Three new variations of each 803 tool take J rated IMPROVE (axe, sword chop, sweeps, thrust, combos, pickaxe, shovel, hammers), each with a different swing and a different way the construct forms; 120 degree first person with a crosshair, ring on the punching face.

takes.name: Axe: straight overhead chop, bite, wrench free
takes.facts: first person at 120 deg with a crosshair, ring on the punching face; hit tick 7; swing 13 ticks, played twice with a 6-tick rest; forms as a pixel stream from the ring (ticks 0-14)

takes.name: Axe: two chops into one notch
takes.facts: first person at 120 deg with a crosshair, ring on the punching face; hits ticks 6, 13; swing 18 ticks, played twice with a 6-tick rest; extrudes out of the fist behind a scan plate (ticks 0-14)
